status: Prospective research protocol; evaluation implementation incomplete
objective: Evaluate whether valuation-guided deployment and rebalancing improve downside outcomes while reporting the return sacrificed.
primary_metric: Maximum daily drawdown of a net total-return equity/debt portfolio
benchmarks: Valuation-only rule with the same costs and observations
cashflow_tests: Lump sum: immediate deployment versus 6- and 12-month equal instalments; undeployed money earns the same debt return
Equal monthly contributions; report terminal wealth and money-weighted return
Inflation-linked retirement withdrawals; publish all withdrawal assumptions before comparing outcomes
implementation_tests: Short-duration debt versus 10-year government-bond total returns
Actual instrument availability, expense ratios, tracking difference, slippage and date-applicable taxes
Rebalance bands of 0, 5 and 10 percentage points
promotion_rule: No automatic winner selection. Record all trials, assess serial dependence and multiple testing, require held-out or prospective evidence, and report return/drawdown tradeoffs. A smaller drawdown alone does not establish skill if it only reflects lower equity exposure.
statistical_plan: Evaluate non-overlapping monthly portfolio returns; use paired time-block resampling for comparisons and disclose block lengths and all tested variants. Overlapping annual outcomes are not independent observations.
historical_limits: Current-vintage historical inputs are not certified point-in-time
Freezing a version now does not validate earlier periods
Pre-April 2021 NIFTY ratios are not directly comparable with the current methodology
Daily archives capture what this project observed, not every original economic release
